1042.description: Lying face down, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.

1106.description: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees toward one side of the chest, which hits the abs and obliques hard.
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and get into a straight-arm plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
Pull both knees toward your chest, twisting them toward one elbow.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips from sagging as you return.

1170.description: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.
instructions: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

1234.description: A back extension holding a plate at your chest. It strengthens the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the hyperextension bench so your hips are just past the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and cross your arms over it.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise your torso until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and avoid overarching.

1298.description: Lying on the floor, press a kettlebell straight up with one arm. The floor limits the range, which is gentle on the shoulder while building the chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the kettlebell in one hand with your palm facing towards your feet and your arm extended straight up towards the ceiling.
Slowly lower the kettlebell towards your chest by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the kettlebell is just above your chest, then push it back up to the starting position by extending your elbow.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住壶铃，手掌朝向脚部，手臂笔直向上伸向天花板。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将壶铃降低到胸部，保持上臂靠近身体。
当壶铃位于胸部正上方时暂停片刻，然后通过伸展肘部将壶铃推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1362.description: Lie face down and prop yourself up on your forearms with your chest lifted. It gently extends the spine and opens the chest.
instructions: Lie face down on the ground with your forearms flat on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and lift your chest off the ground, keeping your forearms and toes on the floor.
Hold this position for a few seconds, making sure to keep your neck in a neutral position.
Slowly lower your chest back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面朝下躺在地上，前臂平放在地板上，肘部直接位于肩膀下方。
收紧核心肌群，将胸部抬离地面，将前臂和脚趾保持在地板上。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，确保颈部保持在中立位置。
慢慢地将胸部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1426.description: Sit in front of a smith machine and curl the bar with your wrists. It strengthens the forearms and builds grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench in front of a Smith machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在史密斯机前的长凳上，双脚平放在地面上。
反握抓住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬垂。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将杠铃拉向前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1490.description: A calf raise with your heels hanging off a stair step for extra range. It trains the calves through a deep stretch.
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or a sturdy platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold onto a railing or wall for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在台阶或坚固平台的边缘，脚后跟悬垂，脚趾放在台阶上。
如果需要，抓住栏杆或墙壁以保持平衡。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1554.description: A jumping lunge where you switch legs in the air while holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a lunge position.
Lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Explode upward and swap your leg positions in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Keep your torso upright and move fluidly from rep to rep.

1618.description: A neutral-grip press on an incline bench set on an exercise ball. The ball adds an unstable challenge for the triceps.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down the ball until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder level, elbows bent and pointing out to the sides.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly inward, keeping your palms facing each other.
Extend your arms fully, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
双脚向前走，身体沿着球滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
将哑铃保持在与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲并指向两侧。
将哑铃向上并稍微向内推，保持手掌相对。
充分伸展双臂，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1682.description: A seated close grip concentration curl using an EZ bar. It isolates the biceps with strict form.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold an EZ barbell with an underhand grip.
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，反手握住 EZ 杠铃。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
将杠铃向上弯向肩膀，同时保持上臂静止。
在动作的最高点挤压二头肌，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1746.description: A dumbbell triceps extension done on an exercise ball, lowering the weight behind your head. Targets the triceps and challenges your balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住哑铃，双臂伸直向天花板方向伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃放到脑后，保持肘部靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1810.description: Pulling one knee toward your chest while lying down stretches your glutes and lower back. A classic, easy hip release.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs extended.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands while the other leg stays flat.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1874.description: One leg at a time on a plate-loaded extension machine, evening out strength between the legs.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and your shins behind the rollers.
Hold the handles.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Lower it slowly.
Repeat with the other leg and keep alternating.

1938.description: A relaxed seated hip stretch with the front leg slightly bent, easy on the knee.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg slightly bent in front of you and the other leg folded comfortably.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back until you feel the hip and buttock stretch.
Keep the knee of the front leg soft throughout.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2130.description: A decline bench crunch with a weight held at the chest, adding resistance for the abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and hook your feet under the pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your upper body up by contracting the abs.
Pause briefly at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2258.description: Plain walking at an easy to brisk pace, a simple way to build endurance and stay active.
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Start walking with a natural stride.
Swing your arms gently opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your heel and roll through to the toes.
Keep a pace that lets you breathe comfortably.
Walk for 20-60 minutes.

2706.description: A lying dumbbell forearm supination on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms to face up, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Slowly curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧在地板上，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧，每只手各握一个哑铃。
将手掌旋转至向上，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，挤压前臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2770.description: Lifting the thigh forward and up, working the hip flexors and front of the thigh.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2834.description: An inverted row on suspension straps with added weight on your body. Builds the back and biceps.
instructions: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

2962.description: A seated machine shoulder press with a neutral hammer grip. It trains the delts with a joint-friendly hand position.
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly to shoulder height and repeat.

3218.description: A standing toe touch with the hands clasped and moved in a circular path. It stretches the hamstrings and warms up the hips and back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手合十放在胸前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双手向脚趾方向以打圈的方式降低，尽量伸得尽可能远，但不要用力。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3282.description: A loaded crunch with the calves on a bench, for stronger abs once bodyweight crunches feel easy.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3410.description: Twist your torso with arms wrapped as if wringing a towel, mobilising the waist and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while your hands twist across.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Keep your hips mostly facing forward.
Continue for 10-15 reps per side.

3474.description: A lying knee-tuck stretch with arms extended overhead for a longer line.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Keep your arms reaching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.
Switch legs.

3538.description: An inverted row with an underhand grip on a bar between two chairs.
instructions: Set a bar across two stable chairs.
Lie under it and grip underhand.
Keep your legs straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower slowly.
Keep your body in a line.

3666.description: A walk on a treadmill with an incline, which makes the glutes and calves work harder. A steady, low impact cardio option.
instructions: Adjust the incline level on the treadmill to your desired intensity.
Stand on the treadmill with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start walking at a comfortable pace, ensuring that you maintain proper form.
Engage your core muscles and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Continue walking on the incline treadmill for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the incline and speed of the treadmill to cool down before stopping.
instructionsZh: 将跑步机的倾斜度调整到您想要的强度。
站在跑步机上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
开始以舒适的步伐行走，确保保持正确的姿势。
在整个练习过程中，调动核心肌肉并保持背部挺直。
继续在倾斜跑步机上行走，完成有氧运动所需的时间。
逐渐降低跑步机的坡度和速度，使其冷却后再停止。

3730.description: A shrug with the bar held behind your thighs, which shifts the load slightly to the mid traps.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with straight arms.
Keep your chest up and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

3794.description: A jumping lunge combined with a one-arm band row. It raises your heart rate and builds leg power.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.

3858.description: A hinged rowing move with a band that works the muscles between and around the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

3922.description: A push-up variation where one hand slides on a towel, shifting load to one side of the chest.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with one hand on a towel on the floor.
Slide that hand out to the side.
Lower your chest toward the other hand.
Push back up.
Slide the towel hand back in.
Switch sides.

3986.description: Raise an EZ bar forward while rotating it. It trains the front delts with a twist.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar at thigh height.
Raise it forward to chest height.
Rotate your wrists as you lift.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

4050.description: Hip thrust with a band across the hips for resistance. It is a direct glute builder.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band across your hips, anchored to each side.
Plant your feet flat, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4114.description: A bent over fly with a band that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand on the band and hinge forward holding the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

4178.description: A barbell squat with heels on a plate for extra knee travel. It emphasises the quads.
instructions: Place your heels on small plates under the bar.
Set the bar on your upper back.
Brace your core and squat down.
Keep your torso upright.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

4242.description: A forward jump followed straight away by a jump up. It trains explosive power in two directions.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and swing your arms back.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Immediately explode into a vertical jump with your arms up.
Land softly and reset.
Take a short rest between reps.

4370.description: A seated calf raise with a barbell on a Smith machine, working the lower calf muscle.
instructions: Sit on a bench under the bar with the balls of your feet on a raised block.
Rest the bar across your thighs with a pad.
Lift your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

4498.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front of the upper arm (biceps brachii). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your front of the upper arm (biceps brachii) on a table or against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4562.description: A side-to-side squat that trains the legs and loads the inner thighs through a big range of motion.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand with a wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Sit deep with your chest up and the straight leg's toes pointing up.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center.
Move into the other side.
Alternate sides with control.

4626.description: A seated tuck crunch holding a dumbbell to work the abs and hip flexors under load.
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs and lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out under control.
Keep your spine long throughout.

4690.description: A single-leg style glute bridge with one ankle resting on the opposite knee.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and one ankle crossed over the other knee.
Press through the grounded foot.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides.

4754.description: A wide side squat with a dumbbell, bending one leg while the other stays straight. It works the thighs and inner legs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Lower until your thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

4818.description: A ring row with the feet raised, making the bodyweight pull harder. It builds the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set the rings at about chest height and rest your heels on a bench.
Grab the rings and hang with arms extended and body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control without letting your hips sag.

4882.description: Lying on your side, you open and close the legs like scissors. Good for the outer hips and the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

5010.description: Decline bench press with a stop on your chest. The pause removes bounce and builds strength out of the bottom.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your lower chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full second.
Press the bar up powerfully until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet secured and shoulder blades tight.

5074.description: Press the end of an angled barbell up and forward. The arc is friendly to the shoulder and trains pressing and trunk stability.
instructions: Anchor one end of a barbell and hold the other end at your shoulder with both hands.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

5202.description: A kneeling crunch pulled down against a resistance band. It adds load to the abs.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and kneel facing it.
Hold the handles beside your head.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips, rounding your spine.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.

5266.description: A twisting crunch with the legs held in the air. It works your abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees raised.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist toward one knee.
Return and twist toward the other side.
Keep a slow rhythm and press your lower back down.

5330.description: Arc a dumbbell from overhead to your chest while lying on a bench. Works the chest and lats with a deep stretch.
instructions: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbell back behind your head in an arc.
Feel the stretch through your chest and lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your hips low and ribs down.

5394.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shin. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with the roller under your shins.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5458.description: Raise one dumbbell diagonally across your body. Works the chest and front shoulder.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell by your opposite hip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally up and across to head height.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5522.description: Pull-up on gymnastic rings, which move freely and demand extra stability from the back and arms.
instructions: Grab the rings and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core and pull your shoulders down.
Pull until the rings reach your chest or chin passes them.
Turn your palms slightly in as you rise if comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

5906.description: A lunge with a twist toward the front leg. Opens the hips and spine.
instructions: Step into a low lunge with your back knee down.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist toward the front leg and hook your elbow outside the knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Switch legs.

5970.description: A slow line walk with each heel touching the toes of the other foot, which trains balance and steady stride control.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides.
Place your right heel directly in front of your left toes.
Shift your weight forward and step again with the other foot.
Keep your eyes forward and your core gently braced.
Walk 10-15 steps, then turn around and return.

6034.description: A deadlift with the bar raised on blocks, which shortens the range of motion and lets you lift heavier.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks or a raised platform.
Stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the bar back to the blocks with control.

6098.description: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.

6162.description: A fly on an incline bench with the dumbbells traveling low. It stretches and works the chest.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back.
Hold dumbbells above your chest with a soft elbow bend.
Open your arms out and down in an arc.
Stop at a comfortable chest stretch.
Bring the dumbbells back together.
Keep the elbow bend constant.

6290.description: A low push-up hold from plank. It builds triceps, chest and core strength.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Shift forward slightly.
Bend your elbows straight back to about 90 degrees.
Keep your body in one line, elbows close to your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.

6354.description: Seated leg press on an outdoor lever machine, pushing the pads away with your legs to train thighs and glutes.
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.

6418.description: A reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, curling your hips up to hit the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.

6546.description: A one-leg hip thrust with a landmine bar across the hips. It hits each glute separately and challenges balance.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with a padded landmine bar across your hips.
Plant one foot on the floor and extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

6738.description: A reverse hyper with your torso on a stability ball and a band adding resistance. It trains glutes and hamstrings while sparing the spine.
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Hold the bench for stability.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.

6802.description: You hold dumbbells overhead while raising the legs alternately. It trains the lower abs and shoulder stability.
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back a little and press the dumbbells overhead.
Keep your arms locked and steady.
Raise one leg off the floor.
Lower it and raise the other leg.
Keep alternating, then lower the weights.

8146.description: A gentle lying breathing drill that lets the pelvic floor and belly relax. It helps you learn calm, deep breathing.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.

8274.description: Lie under a sturdy table and curl your body up by gripping the edge. A bodyweight biceps exercise.
instructions: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.

9042.description: A split squat with the rear foot raised on a bench, done on a smith machine. It targets the quads and glutes with extra stability.
instructions: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

9490.description: A simple step onto a box that trains the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench at a comfortable height.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Press through that heel and stand up on the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

9874.description: A single-arm lateral raise done lying on your side or back on the floor with a low cable crossing the body. It trains the side delt under steady tension.
instructions: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

10194.description: Rock back and forth on your spine with legs in a butterfly position. It massages the back and loosens the hips.
instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.

10386.description: A walking carry with a sandbag across the shoulders, building posture and trunk strength.
instructions: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.

11090.description: An advanced hanging move where you lower slowly toward a front lever. It builds serious core and lat strength.
instructions: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.

11282.description: A sit-up on a glute ham developer with your arms extended. The longer range makes your abs work harder.
instructions: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.

11794.description: A second version of the fingers-on-ball drill for forearm and hand strength.
instructions: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

0018.description: A standing overhead triceps extension holding a towel behind the head. A light way to train the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a towel with both hands behind your head.
Keep your elbows close to your ears and your upper arms stationary.
Slowly extend your forearms upward, squeezing your triceps at the top.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the towel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住毛巾放在脑后。
保持肘部靠近耳朵，上臂保持静止。
慢慢向上伸展前臂，在顶部挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0082.description: A wrist curl with an overhand grip, which trains the extensors on the top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，正手握住杠铃，手掌朝下。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，将杠铃拉向身体。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0210.description: A seated cable wrist curl with an overhand grip, with the wrists hanging past the thighs. It strengthens the top of the forearms.
instructions: Attach a cable to a low pulley and sit on a bench facing the cable machine.
Grasp the cable handle with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆连接到低滑轮上，然后坐在面向电缆机的长凳上。
正手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝下。
将前臂放在大腿上，手腕悬在边缘上。
保持前臂静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后吸气并慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0274.description: A basic floor crunch. You curl the shoulders off the ground to work the upper abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulders off the ground, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将肩膀抬离地面，向前向膝盖弯曲。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0338.description: A lying elbow press with dumbbells. Bending and extending the elbows loads the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and arms extended straight up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then press the dumbbells back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸直越过胸部。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃向肩膀方向降低，保持上臂静止。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸展肘部将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0402.description: Seated at a preacher bench, you curl dumbbells with your upper arms on the pad. It keeps tension on the biceps.
instructions: Sit on a preacher curl bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your upper arm against the preacher pad.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，双脚平放在地板上。
一只手握住哑铃，反手握住，将上臂靠在讲道垫上。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0466.description: A chin-up variation where you pull toward the sternum. It builds the lats, upper back and biceps.
instructions: Stand facing a high bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your lats and biceps to pull your chest up towards the bar, leading with your sternum.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向高杠站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
向上伸手，正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
用你的背阔肌和二头肌将你的胸部拉向杠铃杆，以胸骨为主导。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0530.description: Holding two kettlebells, you hinge sideways with one overhead. It trains the obliques, shoulders and hips.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand.
Extend your right arm overhead, keeping your eyes on the kettlebell.
Rotate your left foot 45 degrees to the left and your right foot 90 degrees to the right.
Bend at the waist to the left, keeping your right arm extended overhead.
Lower the kettlebell towards the ground, reaching towards your left foot.
Pause for a moment, then engage your core and push through your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住壶铃。
将右臂伸过头顶，眼睛盯着壶铃。
左脚向左旋转 45 度，右脚向右旋转 90 度。
腰部向左弯曲，保持右臂伸过头顶。
将壶铃向地面降低，伸向左脚。
暂停片刻，然后启动核心并推动右脚返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0594.description: Seated on a machine, you press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels. Isolates the calves, especially the soleus.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使膝盖稍微弯曲，双脚平放在踏板上。
将脚趾放在踏板上，脚跟悬在踏板边缘。
抓住把手或座椅侧面以保持稳定性。
推动脚掌，将脚后跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0658.description: A push-up against a wall, a gentle version for beginners. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back with your feet, keeping them hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the wall, keeping your body straight.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，距离大约一臂距离。
将双手放在墙上，与肩同高，距离略宽于肩宽。
双脚向后退一步，保持与臀部同宽。
收紧核心肌群，保持身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向墙壁降低，保持身体挺直。
暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0722.description: A bridge with a sideways leg shift. It trains the glutes and hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step or shift your legs to one side.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides.
Keep your hips lifted.

0786.description: An Olympic lift where you dip, drive the bar overhead and catch it in a split stance. It builds explosive power and overhead stability.
instructions: Start with the barbell resting on your shoulders, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your legs and push the barbell overhead.
As the barbell reaches its peak, quickly drop into a split position, with one foot forward and one foot back.
Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your back knee slightly touching the ground.
Stand up from the split position, bringing your feet back together.
Lower the barbell back to your shoulders and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先将杠铃放在肩膀上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将身体降低至蹲姿，保持挺胸，膝盖位于脚趾上方。
当你到达深蹲底部时，爆发性地用腿发力，并将杠铃推过头顶。
当杠铃到达最高点时，迅速落入分体位置，一脚向前，一脚向后。
双臂完全伸展，后膝盖稍微接触地面，将杠铃举过头顶。
从分开的位置站起来，将双脚重新并拢。
将杠铃放回肩膀处，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0850.description: A side bend on a stability ball holding a weight in one hand. It trains the obliques.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet shoulder-width apart and flat on the ground.
Hold a weight in one hand and place your other hand on your hip.
Engage your core and slowly bend sideways towards the weighted side, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚分开与肩同宽，平放在地面上。
一只手握住重物，另一只手放在臀部上。
启动你的核心，慢慢向受重侧侧弯，保持背部挺直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0978.description: A front raise with a band, raising both arms forward. It builds the front shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and slowly raise them forward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝下。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢向前举起，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
